deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting tagged deploy to production
- release tag: `release/1.2.3-hotfix-2026-03-19`
- commit: `abcdef1234567890`
- initiated by: @sara
- change window: immediate (no maintenance page)
- ETA: ~6m

sara: Kicking this off, small patch to fix tokenizer overflow in v1.2.3. Monitoring dashboards on the usual panel.

mike: Noted. Can we pin the canary LB to the new tag for 2 mins first?

sara: Yes, doing a 2m canary then promote.

deploy-bot: Canary finished (2m). No errors in logs, traffic at 5% for canary. Proceeding to promote.

ops-bot: Metric alert: `5xx_rate > 0.5%` on model-inference-prod at 2026-03-19T15:02:10Z (source: prom).

ken: seeing a small spike in 5xx across rtx-nodes. Rolling back? Need quick triage on whether this is the hotfix or unrelated infra blip.

mike: Logs show `KV cache OOM` on one pod around the same time. Could be config mismatch in compiled kernels for the new quantization path.

sara: Hm — this hotfix touched tokenizer only but we did flip a safer quantization flag in runtime config for this deploy. I want to rollback the quant flag first if possible.

ken: Agree. If we can flip config without full rollback that'd be less risky. @sara can you revert `runtime.quant_mode=safe` -> `runtime.quant_mode=stable` via the infra toggle?

sara: Trying the toggle now: `infra toggle set runtime.quant_mode stable --env prod --tag release/1.2.3-hotfix-2026-03-19`

deploy-bot: Configuration change applied to 80% of nodes. Re-evaluating 5xx rate.

ops-bot: Metric update: `5xx_rate` reduced to 0.12% after config revert.

ken: Nice, looks like the quant flag was the culprit. No full rollback needed. Recommend letting the change propagate for 5 more minutes, then promote remaining nodes.

sara: Agreed. Will hold full rollback. Rolling forward with patch: completing promotion incrementally.

mike: Add a postmortem note and tag the runtime team for follow-up on safer quant rollout gating.

sara: Added TODO in the release notes and created ticket INF-3421 for gating.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Deploy complete — release/1.2.3-hotfix-2026-03-19 successfully promoted to production.
- duration: 10m 24s
- final status: success (with transient config rollback during rollout)
- notes: runtime.quant_mode reverted mid-deploy due to increased 5xx; no user-facing data loss.

ken: Great coordination, thanks.

mike: We should pin the quant-mode in dedicated testbed and run kernel compatibility tests before next production flip.

sara: Will schedule a canary run and add to pre-deploy checklist.

ops-bot: Filed incident annotation: `deploy-1782000456` — brief config revert during promotion, resolved. Link: https://redwood-internal/incident/1782000456

sara: Closing thread, will follow up in INF-3421 and the next weekly release sync. :slightly_smiling_face:
